title: Crediting Stored Value Already Standing on the Account against a Paydown
content:
Value the employee has already put onto their Employee Meal Account may stand to their credit when a paydown is worked out. Whether it does, and how much of it does, turns on how much is standing and how lately it was loaded. The recent load window for this purpose is 90 calendar days and the dormant share is 50 percent.

**Clause.** Where the stored value standing is at least the smallest single load the plan accepts and a load has been made on the account within the recent load window, the credit for stored value is the whole of the stored value standing. Where the stored value standing is at least that smallest single load and the last load was made before the recent load window opened, the credit is the dormant share of the stored value standing, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where neither holds, nothing is credited.

## The smallest single load this reads, plan by plan

| Meal plan | Smallest single load the plan accepts |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | $0.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | $10.00 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | $5.00 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | $5.00 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | $0.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | $20.00 |

## The bands

| Stored value standing | Latest load on the account | Credited against the gross paydown |
|---|---|---|
| At least the plan's smallest single load | Within the last 90 calendar days | All of the stored value standing |
| At least the plan's smallest single load | More than 90 calendar days ago, or never loaded | 50 percent of the stored value standing |
| Below the plan's smallest single load | Either | Nothing |

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

An account holding $64.00 of stored value on a plan whose smallest single load is $5.00, last loaded 40 calendar days ago, is credited the whole $64.00. The same account last loaded 200 calendar days ago is credited 50 percent of $64.00, or $32.00, rounded at that step. An account holding $3.00 on the same plan is credited nothing, because $3.00 is below the $5.00 smallest single load, and the age of the last load then makes no difference.
